en.name: Sugar snap peas
en.summary: Sugar snap peas are plump, rounded pods with fully formed peas inside, eaten whole and eaten crunchy. Refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below they keep 3–5 days from the day of purchase, and blanched and frozen they hold good quality for about 8 months.
en.pantry: Sugar snaps should not be kept at room temperature. Peas are among the fastest vegetables to convert sugar into starch after picking, and warmth accelerates it — a bag left out for an afternoon will taste noticeably less sweet by dinner, quite apart from going limp. There is no room-temperature figure here and none should be assumed. Refrigerate them unwashed as soon as you get home.
en.fridge: Store sugar snaps unwashed in a perforated bag in the crisper at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, where they keep 3–5 days from purchase. Keep them dry; condensation in a sealed bag makes the pods slimy where they touch each other. Do not string or top them until you cook. As with all peas, the flavour drops off faster than the appearance, so a pod that still looks fine on day five will taste starchier than it did on day one.
en.freezer: Sugar snaps freeze well with a short blanch. String them, boil for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water, drain thoroughly and freeze flat in a sealed bag at −18 °C (0 °F). They are safe indefinitely and keep good quality for about 8 months. Blanching is not optional here: without it the enzymes carry on working and the pods go dull, tough and grassy-tasting within weeks.
en.thawing: Cook sugar snaps from frozen, adding them at the very end of a stir-fry or dropping them into boiling water for a minute. Thawing first leaves them limp and they will never be crunchy again.
spoilage: Pods gone limp and leathery, bending instead of snapping
Yellowing pods, or brown spots spreading along them
Slimy or blackened patches where pods were pressed together
A sour smell, or mould at the stem ends
tips: Choose plump, bright green, squeaky pods that snap cleanly when bent.
String them just before cooking by snapping the stem and pulling down the seam.
Cook them for barely a minute, or eat them raw — they are one of the best raw vegetables there is.
Store unwashed and dry in a perforated bag.

faq.q: How long do sugar snap peas last in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–5 days from the day of purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, unwashed and dry in a perforated bag in the crisper.

faq.q: Can you freeze sugar snap peas?
faq.a: Yes, after blanching for 2 minutes. Frozen flat at −18 °C (0 °F) they keep good quality for about 8 months.

faq.q: Can you eat sugar snap peas raw?
faq.a: Yes, and they are excellent raw — string them first and eat them as fresh as possible, because the sweetness fades quickly after picking.

faq.q: What is the difference between sugar snaps and snow peas?
faq.a: Sugar snaps are plump with fully formed peas inside and a thicker, crunchier pod. Snow peas are flat and picked before the peas develop. Both are eaten whole.

zh.name: 甜豆
zh.summary: 甜豆是圓鼓鼓、裡面豆仁已經飽滿的豆莢，連莢整個吃、吃的就是那份脆。4°C 以下冷藏，從購買當天算起可放 3～5 天；汆燙後冷凍則可維持約 8 個月的良好品質。
zh.pantry: 甜豆不應該放室溫。豌豆類是採收後糖轉澱粉最快的蔬菜之一，溫度高又會加速這個過程——一袋在檯面上放了一個下午的甜豆，晚餐時吃起來會明顯沒那麼甜，更別說已經軟垂了。這裡不提供常溫保存天數，也請不要自行推估。買回家請不清洗直接冷藏。
zh.fridge: 不清洗，裝進打洞袋放在 4°C 以下的蔬果保鮮室，從購買日起可放 3～5 天。請保持乾燥；密封袋內凝結的水會讓豆莢互相接觸的地方變黏。要煮之前才撕絲、摘蒂。和所有豌豆一樣，它的風味掉得比外觀快，所以第五天看起來還不錯的豆莢，吃起來會比第一天粉得多。
zh.freezer: 甜豆只要短暫汆燙就很適合冷凍。撕掉粗絲，滾水煮 2 分鐘，泡冰水冷卻，徹底瀝乾後平鋪裝密封袋放 −18°C。安全上可無限期保存，品質可維持約 8 個月。汆燙在這裡不是可選項：不燙的話酵素會繼續作用，幾週內豆莢就會變得暗沉、變韌，還帶青草味。
zh.thawing: 甜豆請不解凍直接煮，在快炒的最後一刻下鍋，或丟進滾水煮一分鐘。先解凍只會軟掉，而且再也脆不回來。
spoilage: 豆莢軟韌像皮革，折起來只是彎而不會斷
豆莢泛黃，或出現褐斑並擴散
豆莢互相壓著的地方出現黏滑或發黑的斑塊
tips: 挑飽滿翠綠、摸起來有澀感、折下去會清脆斷開的。
要煮之前再撕絲：折斷蒂頭後沿著縫線往下拉。
下鍋一分鐘就好，或乾脆生吃——甜豆是最好吃的生食蔬菜之一。
不清洗、保持乾燥裝在打洞袋裡保存。

faq.q: 甜豆放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 4°C 以下冷藏，不清洗、保持乾燥裝在打洞袋放蔬果室，從購買當天算起 3～5 天。
可以，先汆燙 2 分鐘。平鋪冷凍於 −18°C，品質可維持約 8 個月。
可以，而且非常好吃——先把粗絲撕掉，並盡量趁新鮮吃，因為採收後甜味消失得很快。

faq.q: 甜豆和荷蘭豆有什麼不同？
faq.a: 甜豆圓鼓鼓、裡面豆仁飽滿，莢也較厚較脆；荷蘭豆是扁的，趁豆仁還沒長大就採收。兩者都連莢整個吃。
